# Surge Power Services

> Surge Power Services LLC is a commercial and industrial trades company based in Leola, Pennsylvania. It provides skilled tradesmen and licensed electricians for commercial electrical, industrial electrical, commercial HVAC and plumbing, residential electrical, and manpower staffing across Pennsylvania, Maryland, New Jersey, and nationwide.

Key facts:
- Company: Surge Power Services LLC
- Address: 218 W Main Street, Leola, PA 17540
- Phone: (717) 521-1616
- Email: surgepower@surgepower.com
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm
- Service area: Pennsylvania, Maryland, New Jersey, and nationwide deployment for commercial and industrial projects

## Services

- [Commercial Electrical Services](https://www.surgepower.com/commercial-electrical-services): commercial electricians for new construction, fit-outs, panel upgrades, lighting, and power distribution
- [Industrial Electrical Services](https://www.surgepower.com/industrial-electrical-services): industrial electricians for plants, manufacturing facilities, data centers, and heavy industrial environments
- [Commercial HVAC and Plumbing](https://www.surgepower.com/commercial-hvac-services): commercial HVAC installation and maintenance, ductwork, rooftop units, and commercial plumbing
- [Residential Electrical](https://www.surgepower.com/residential-electrical-services): licensed residential electricians serving Central Pennsylvania homeowners
- [Manpower and Labor Services](https://www.surgepower.com/manpower-services): vetted skilled trade labor and staffing for contractors, typically deployable within 24-48 hours of a confirmed request
